comments.author: Alex Kim
comments.body: Deployed schema bump; re-saved views keep all components. Backfill script rewrote 412 views that had been truncated.

content.text: Deployed schema bump; re-saved views keep all components. Backfill script rewrote 412 views that had been truncated.

Saved views on the dashboard can include multiple component filters. When a view is saved with four or more components selected, only the first three are applied when the view is loaded; the rest are silently dropped from the active filter state (though still visible as selected in the edit dialog until save).
All selected components should participate in the query. Boards filtered by four components show a superset of cards because the fourth filter never reaches GET /issues.

The saved-view JSON schema used components as a fixed string array of length 3 from an early product limit. The UI allowed more selections but serialization truncated with slice(0, 3). Schema and mapper now accept up to 25 components.
